title: Swara Bhasker Hosts Qawwali Baithak at Home to Celebrate Diwali After Rise and Fall
excerpt: The actor welcomed Priyanka Chahar Choudhary, Faye D'Souza and designer Aprajita Toor for an evening of live Qawwali by Arif Naza and party, telling Filmibeat she wanted a celebration that felt intimate, warm and full of life.
body:
• Swara Bhasker hosted an intimate Qawwali baithak at her residence for Diwali 2026, after spending time away from home on the reality show Rise and Fall Season 2.
  • The evening's highlight was a Qawwali performance by Arif Naza and party, featuring Fahad Ahmad. Guests included Priyanka Chahar Choudhary, Faye D'Souza and designer Aprajita Toor.
  • She told Filmibeat in an exclusive interview that she wanted a celebration that felt "intimate, warm and full of life," centred on live music, family and friends.
  • Context for viewers: Rise and Fall Season 2, hosted by Virender Sehwag and streaming on Prime Video, headed into its finale on November 6 with Swara and Priyanka both among the finalists, Variety India reported.

Diwali celebrations took a musical turn at Swara Bhasker's residence this year, where the actor hosted an intimate Qawwali baithak for family, friends and familiar faces. The evening, reported in an exclusive Filmibeat interview, came after Swara spent an eventful stretch away from home inside the Rise and Fall Season 2 house.

The baithak

The highlight of the evening was a Qawwali performance by Arif Naza and party, featuring Fahad Ahmad. The gathering brought together guests from different walks of life, including Priyanka Chahar Choudhary, journalist Faye D'Souza and designer Aprajita Toor. Swara's father also drew mention in Filmibeat's account for his warm, gracious hosting, which the report said made guests feel at home.

"Music has a beautiful way of bringing people together, and a Qawwali baithak felt like the perfect way to celebrate. There is something so soulful about live Qawwali; it creates an atmosphere that is difficult to put into words."

— Swara Bhasker, in an exclusive interview with Filmibeat

Why this Diwali felt different

Talking about bringing in Diwali after her experience on Rise and Fall, Swara said: "This Diwali feels particularly special because I have spent a considerable amount of time away from the comfort of home while being part of Rise and Fall. Coming back to familiar surroundings and celebrating with family and friends is such a beautiful feeling. You realise how much these little moments mean to you. Having everyone together, sharing conversations, laughter and good food makes the festival even more meaningful. I wanted to celebrate in a way that felt intimate, warm and full of life."

She added: "After all the excitement, experiences and emotions of the show, being back home and celebrating with people I love is something I am genuinely grateful for. Sometimes, the simplest celebrations turn out to be the most memorable ones." For her, she said, Diwali is about "light, positivity, love and togetherness" and making time for people who matter.

The show she came home from

Rise and Fall Season 2 is the reality competition hosted by former cricketer Virender Sehwag, in his debut as a streaming-show host, and streams on Prime Video. According to Variety India, the season headed towards its finale on November 6, with Swara Bhasker, Shehzad Poonawalla, Gautam Gulati and Karan Patel qualified for the finals from the main house, and Priyanka Chahar Choudhary and Niharika Tiwari chosen from the basement players. Arjun Bijlani won the first season. That made the baithak a reunion of sorts: Priyanka, Swara's fellow finalist, was among the guests at the Diwali evening.

Swara Bhasker, known for Hindi films including Tanu Weds Manu and Raanjhanaa, concluded of the evening: "This evening had everything I love about the festival — beautiful music, wonderful people and so much warmth. I couldn't have asked for a better way to welcome Diwali."
